CDF-AS1.name: Broad prospecting (cold)
CDF-AS1.who: Everyone 18-65 in Italy, no interest targeting (Advantage+ broad). The widest and cheapest audience in the account, mostly people who have never heard of the brand.
evidence: Largest budget and the lowest CPM in every advertiser: Meta finds cheap impressions because the pool is huge.
Highest reach per euro and frequency pinned at 1.03: almost nobody sees an ad twice.
Lowest CTR: a cold stranger rarely clicks.
Almost no fatigue (week-4 CTR is 92-97% of week-0): the pool refreshes itself.
Black Friday lever under-indexes (0.8-0.9x): a cold audience is not waiting for this brand's sale.
CDF-AS1.implication: Use it for reach and for creative that explains the product. Keep heavy-text graphics out: this is where they hurt most.

CDF-AS2.name: Interest / lookalike, deal-driven, younger
CDF-AS2.who: Interest-based or 1-3% lookalike of past buyers, skewed 25-34, Instagram-heavy, responds to deals and to people on camera.
evidence: Mid budget, CPM 10-20% above ad set 1: a narrower pool, but still cold (frequency 1.03).
Fastest fatigue after the warm set (week-4 CTR is ~70% of week-0): the pool is finite.
Black Friday lever over-indexes strongly (1.2-1.7x) and scarcity over-indexes: deal hunters.
Weekend CTR slightly higher (Saturday +6%): leisure browsing, not desk browsing.
Video and talking-to-camera creatives beat images by 1.3-1.7x.
CDF-AS2.implication: The right place for promo creatives in Black Week. Rotate creatives every 3-4 weeks; it burns out.

CDF-AS3.name: Narrow premium interest, older
CDF-AS3.who: Tight interest stack (premium skincare / premium pet food / mid-range fashion), skewed 35-54, higher income, trust-driven rather than deal-driven.
evidence: Smallest budget yet CPM close to the warm set: an expensive, narrow pool.
Frequency 1.035, slightly above the other cold sets: a smaller pool reached more than once.
Black Friday lever under-indexes most (0.6-0.7x): price is not what moves them.
Scarcity creatives over-index and 'talking to camera' creatives get the biggest lift of any set (1.4x).
Almost no fatigue (0.9-1.0): a loyal, stable segment that tolerates the same creative.
CDF-AS3.implication: Sell quality and proof, not discounts. The dermatologist video and the numbered-kit carousel belong here.

CDF-AS4.name: Retargeting (warm)
CDF-AS4.who: Site visitors, add-to-cart and past customers of the last 30-90 days. People who already know the brand and are deciding whether to buy.
evidence: CTR about 2x the cold sets in every advertiser: warm people click.
Frequency 1.20-1.24 against 1.03 elsewhere: a small pool, so the same people see the ad again.
Lowest reach per euro and the highest CPM: competition for warm users is expensive and the pool is small.
Strongest fatigue of all (week-4 CTR is 60-72% of week-0): once the pool has seen it, it is done.
Black Friday lever over-indexes 1.35-1.6x and Friday-to-Sunday CTR is above average: they were waiting for the price drop.
CDF-AS4.implication: Highest click volume per euro. Load Black Friday creatives here first, refresh weekly, and cap frequency.
